## Kai-Wei Chang Profile Research Notes

### Position & Background
- Associate Professor, UCLA Computer Science (since Jul 2022; Assistant Prof Jul 2017-2022)
- Co-director, UCLA DataX AI Technology Center
- PhD from University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC)
- 2021 Sloan Research Fellow
- 2024 IEEE AI's 10 to Watch (Top 10 Rising Stars in AI)
- 30+ top-cited and awarded AI papers, 20+ NSF/DoD/industry projects

### Core Research Directions
1. **Trustworthy NLP / AI Safety**: Gender bias in word embeddings (NeurIPS 2016 seminal paper), bias amplification (EMNLP 2017 Best Long Paper), LLM unlearning, customized guardrails, SafeWorld, over-refusal mitigation
2. **Vision-Language / Multimodal AI**: VisualBERT, GLIP (CVPR 2022 Best Paper Finalist), VideoCon, VideoPhy, OpenVLThinker, MathVista, MathVerse
3. **LLM Reasoning & Agents**: Chameleon (plug-and-play compositional reasoning), Agent Lumos, Embodied Web Agents, Ctrl-R (structured reasoning), OpenThoughts (data recipes for reasoning models), DACO (divide-and-conquer reasoning)
4. **AI for Math**: MathVista benchmark (widely used, 1800+ citations), MathVerse, HAGeo (gold-medal geometry solving), expMath (DARPA $5M contract), AI4Math Moonshot (with Terence Tao)
5. **Information Extraction / NLP**: PolicyQA, TextEE, SPEED, KPEval, MetaKP
6. **Constrained Generation / Controllable AI**: Semantic probabilistic layers, controllable generation, divide-and-conquer for LLM control

### Lab Size & Structure (UCLA NLP Group)
- **Current PhD students** (active): Christina Chance, Cheng-Fu Yang, Amita Kamath, Di Wu, Elaine Wan, Rui Sun, Xueqing Wu, Bryan Zhou, Wenbo Hu, Eric Jiang, Xiao Liang, Steven Swee
- **Postdocs/Visiting Scholars**: James Zhecan Wang, Yining Hong, Yiwei Wang, Pan Lu, Kareem Ahmed, Kuan-Hao Huang, Md. Rizwan Parvez, Ziniu Hu
- **Alumni placed in academia**: Jieyu Zhao (Asst Prof @ UVA), Muhao Chen (Asst Prof @ UC Davis), Hritik Bansal (now at...), Fan Yin, Wade Yin
- Total group: ~15-20 active members at any time

### Recent Publications (2024-2026) - Agent/LLM Focus
2026:
- Ctrl-R: Learning Structured Reasoning via Tractable Trajectory Control (ICML 2026 Spotlight, top 2.2%)
- OpenThoughts: Data Recipes for Reasoning Models (ICLR 2026 oral, top 1.8%)
- Training LLMs for Divide-and-Conquer Reasoning
- Dynamic Generation of Multi LLM Agents Communication Topologies with Graph Diffusion Models
- BRIEF-Pro: Universal Context Compression for Multi-Hop Reasoning
- AutoSUIT Bench
- ContextNav

2025:
- OpenVLThinker: Open-source multimodal reasoning
- Embodied Web Agents
- Magnet: Multi-agent communication
- METAL: Multi-agent learning
- QLASS: Quality assessment
- LongMemEval: Long context evaluation
- MuirBench: Multimodal reasoning benchmark
- Customized Guardrails for LLMs
- LLM Unlearning (Jin et al.)
- X-Teaming: Multi-agent teaming
- LUME: LLM unlearning

2024:
- Agent Lumos: Learning open-world agent with LLMs
- MathVista (NeurIPS 2024)
- MathVerse
- SafeWorld: Safety in LLM agents
- Re-ReST: Reasoning self-training
- DACO: Divide-and-conquer reasoning
- JourneyBench
- Control LLMs via Divide and Conquer
- QUDSELECT
- Tree-of-Traversals

### Student Mentoring Style
- Students are first authors on most papers, indicating strong hands-on mentoring
- Diverse collaboration patterns: works with students from CS, linguistics, engineering backgrounds
- Many papers co-authored with multiple students (collaborative lab culture)
- Alumni have placed in top academia (UVA, UC Davis) and industry
- Active GitHub organization (uclanlp) with open-source code releases

### Current Openings
- Application page: https://web.cs.ucla.edu/~kwchang/application
- Has a Google Form for prospective students
- Has an application info PDF
- Recruiting PhD students and possibly postdocs
- Research areas: NLP, multimodal AI, trustworthy ML, AI for math

### Key URLs
- Homepage: http://web.cs.ucla.edu/~kwchang/
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=fqDBtzYAAAAJ
- GitHub: https://github.com/uclanlp
- Publications: https://web.cs.ucla.edu/~kwchang/publications/
- Members: https://web.cs.ucla.edu/~kwchang/members/
- Application: https://web.cs.ucla.edu/~kwchang/application

> 调研日期：2025-06-29
> 信息来源：UCLA CS 主页、Publications 页面、Google Scholar、Members 页面、Samueli 工程学院页面

---

## 1. 个人背景与学术地位

| 项目 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| **职称** | Associate Professor, UCLA Computer Science (2022.7–至今) |
| **曾任** | Assistant Professor, UCLA CS (2017–2022) |
| **博士** | University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) |
| **实验室** | UCLA NLP Group (Co-director, UCLA DataX AI Technology Center) |
| **荣誉** | 2021 Sloan Research Fellow; 2024 IEEE AI's 10 to Watch (Top 10 Rising Stars in AI) |
| **学术服务** | Vice President-Elect (2024), VP (2025), President (2026) of ACL; JAIR/JMLR/TACL Action Editor |

---

## 2. 核心研究方向

Kai-Wei Chang 的研究横跨 **自然语言处理、多模态 AI、AI 安全与推理**，主要方向如下：

### 2.1 Trustworthy NLP / AI Safety（可信 AI）
- **性别偏见检测与消除**：NeurIPS 2016 关于词嵌入性别偏见的开创性工作（高引）
- **偏见放大**：EMNLP 2017 Best Long Paper
- **LLM Unlearning**：使大模型"遗忘"特定知识（2024–2025 多篇论文）
- **Customized Guardrails**：为 LLM 定制安全护栏
- **SafeWorld**：LLM Agent 安全框架
- **Over-refusal 缓解**：解决 LLM 过度拒绝合理请求的问题

### 2.2 Vision-Language / Multimodal AI（视觉-语言/多模态）
- **VisualBERT**：多模态预训练模型
- **GLIP**：CVPR 2022 Best Paper Finalist（图文定位）
- **VideoCon / VideoPhy**：视频理解与物理常识推理
- **OpenVLThinker**：开源多模态推理模型（2025）
- **MathVista / MathVerse**：数学视觉推理基准

### 2.3 LLM Reasoning & Agents（LLM 推理与智能体）
- **Chameleon**：即插即用的组合式推理框架
- **Agent Lumos**：基于 LLM 的开放世界 Agent 学习（2024）
- **Embodied Web Agents**：具身化网页 Agent（2025）
- **Ctrl-R**：结构化推理轨迹控制（ICML 2026 Spotlight, top 2.2%）
- **OpenThoughts**：推理模型的数据配方（ICLR 2026 Oral, top 1.8%）
- **DACO**：分治推理（Divide-and-Conquer Reasoning）

### 2.4 AI for Math（AI 数学）
- **MathVista**：广泛使用的数学视觉推理基准（1800+ 引用）
- **MathVerse**：数学推理评测
- **HAGeo**：金牌级几何解题系统
- **expMath**：DARPA $5M 合同项目
- **AI4Math Moonshot**：与陶哲轩（Terence Tao）合作

### 2.5 其他方向
- **Information Extraction**：PolicyQA, TextEE, SPEED, KPEval, MetaKP
- **Constrained Generation**：语义概率层、可控生成
